node.statement: Because 0 <= epsilon_r <= epsilon_*^r <= 1/4 and 0 <= q <= delta_*/12 <= 1/48, one has 1+epsilon_r+q <= 61/48 < 3. Together with C_path*q <= delta_*/12 and eta = C_path*q*(1+epsilon_r+q), this gives eta <= delta_*/4; moreover delta_*/4 < 3*delta_*/4 <= r_-, so eta < r_-.
